title: Notification setting toggle is never saved

evidence.quote: func setShouldShowNotifications(_ enabled: Bool) async throws

reasoning: SettingsView loads the notification preference from SettingsRepository and the protocol/repository tests establish that it is meant to be persisted, but the UI toggle only mutates local @State. Leaving and re-entering Settings reloads the stored value, and any services reading the repository never see the user's change.
reproduction: Open Settings, turn off Show Digest Completion, leave the screen, and reopen Settings. The toggle returns to the previously persisted value because no setter is called.
recommendation: Use a Binding setter that calls settingsRepository.setShouldShowNotifications(_:) and reverts or surfaces an error if persistence fails.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included repository test verifies the persistence API directly, but there is no SettingsView test that toggles the UI and asserts the repository value changes. App/Tests/EpilogueTests.swift is a placeholder.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a SettingsView interaction test with a mock SettingsRepositoryProtocol that toggles Show Digest Completion and expects setShouldShowNotifications(false) to be invoked.
